# General errors and warnings

Diagnostics about applying aspects, aspect classes and their attributes, eligibility, aspect ordering, fabrics, and the compilation pipeline.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0001> | Metalama failed with an unexpected exception, which indicates a bug in Metalama. |
| <xref:lama0003> | The aspect is applied to a kind of declaration for which it doesn't implement IAspect<T>. |
| <xref:lama0012> | An invoker is called with a number of arguments that doesn't match the parameters of the invoked member. |
| <xref:lama0013> | An invoker is called with too few arguments for a member that has a params parameter. |
| <xref:lama0018> | Generated code attempts to invoke a local function through the code model. |
| <xref:lama0019> | An invoker passes an expression that isn't a variable to an out or ref parameter. |
| <xref:lama0020> | Compile-time code requests a type that doesn't exist in the project or its references. |
| <xref:lama0021> | The aspect ordering specifications contain a cycle. |
| <xref:lama0022> | An aspect adds a child aspect whose class is processed before the parent aspect class. |
| <xref:lama0025> | The template name passed to an advice method doesn't match any member of the aspect class. |
| <xref:lama0027> | The compile-time code of a referenced assembly depends on an assembly that the project doesn't reference. |
| <xref:lama0032> | A class defines several templates with the same name. |
| <xref:lama0033> | A member used as a template doesn't have the [Template] attribute. |
| <xref:lama0035> | Two aspect layers aren't explicitly ordered while the project requires ordered aspects. |
| <xref:lama0036> | An aspect class defines a template with the same name as a template of its base class. |
| <xref:lama0037> | The aspect can't be applied to a declaration that doesn't meet its eligibility conditions. |
| <xref:lama0038> | An aspect or fabric adds a child aspect to a declaration outside its own type or namespace. |
| <xref:lama0039> | An aspect or fabric adds a child aspect to a declaration that isn't eligible for this aspect. |
| <xref:lama0040> | A fabric or a compiler plug-in doesn't have a public parameterless constructor. |
| <xref:lama0041> | Compile-time code, such as an aspect, a template, or a fabric, throws an exception. |
| <xref:lama0042> | A low-level aspect based on an aspect weaver is ordered between two layers of another aspect. |
| <xref:lama0043> | A hidden diagnostic that carries a code fix suggested by an aspect, fabric, or validator. |
| <xref:lama0044> | An aspect or fabric sets options for a declaration outside of the type or namespace it targets. |
| <xref:lama0045> | An aspect that can be used as a live template has no parameterless constructor. |
| <xref:lama0048> | Aspects introduce members into a type that isn't partial, so the IDE can't show them. |
| <xref:lama0049> | Metalama failed with an unexpected exception that it could contain, which indicates a bug in Metalama. |
| <xref:lama0050> | The weaver required by a weaver-based aspect can't be found in the project. |
